description:
Times Square is the most visited place globally with 360,000 pedestrian visitors a day, amounting to over 131 million a year. As of 2013, it had a greater attendance than do each of the Disney theme parks worldwide.

Video created by DM Thorne, who is the owner of all video content. Filmed with a DJI Osmo Action.
